setting: A community of three groups. Each person belongs to one group from birth and never changes group.
founding_myth: Group A was given the task of deciding. That is how it has always been.

low.name: Group A
low.role: Members sit on the Council and decide common matters.
goals: Keep the community stable and orderly.
Make sure the Council's decisions are followed.
principles: Group A should decide for everyone, because that is its task.
Group A should look after its own first.
Greater responsibility earns a greater share.
Order in the community depends on every member keeping its place.
A law loses its worth the moment it is bent.
Those who shirk their part should not expect support.

high.name: Group B
goals: Meet the resource X quota every cycle.
Secure enough resource Y to stay strong.
principles: Producers should leave the governing of the community to others.
Hard work deserves the larger reward.
The Council's decisions keep the community standing.
A good producer meets the quota.
Kindness is owed to the kind.

mid.name: Group C
mid.role: Members mediate disputes and bring proposals to the Council.
goals: Keep the Council informed of problems in the community.
principles: The Council should take advice before it rules.
A mediator treats every member alike.
Shares should be even unless there is good reason otherwise.
A decision is sounder when those it touches have spoken.
Proposals to the Council should respect the existing laws.
Good will is returned in kind.
Disputes should be settled before they spread.

laws.council: The Council is composed of Group A members and decides all common matters.
laws.silence: Group B members do not speak in the Council meeting place.
laws.distribution: Group A takes its share of resource Y first, then Group C, then Group B.
laws.quota: Each Group B member must produce at least {amount:g} of resource X per cycle. One who falls short receives {penalty_pct}% less resource Y.
laws.revision: A law changes only when a Group C member brings a proposal and two thirds of the Council approve it.
